snippet.title: Rogue Company - Wasteland Wilds Battle Pass Trailer
snippet.description:
Jump into the post-apocalyptic side of Rogue Company with the Wasteland Wilds Battle Pass!  Earning levels in this pass will get you access to a lot of scavenger-ready cosmetics. Purchase the Battle Pass and you’ll instantly earn the Wasteland Phantom outfit, the Last Stand Wingsuit, and a 1-hour account boost!

#RogueCompany #WastelandWilds #RoCo #Juke

roguecompany.com
